identity.name: Eco-Fintech Billing
identity.description: A minimalist, high-performance billing system that blends financial precision with organic calm. Green is not just a color; it's a signal of growth and stability.
principles: Fusion: Fintech Precision x Botanical Calm
Density with Breath: High data density for admins, open space for subscribers
Role-Based Atmosphere: Distinct visual modes for Admin (Command), Cashier (Speed), and Subscriber (Ease)

usage.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none font-heading
usage.caption: text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-muted-foreground/70 font-mono

role_themes.admin: Theme: 'Command Center'. Dark sidebars, high contrast data, 'Grid Borders' surface style.
role_themes.cashier: Theme: 'Speed & Focus'. High contrast buttons, large touch targets, 'Neumorphism' for keypads.
role_themes.technician: Theme: 'Field Utility'. High legibility, card-based (mobile friendly), 'Tactile' surfaces.
role_themes.subscriber: Theme: 'Organic Ease'. Soft gradients, 'Glassmorphism', friendly illustrations.

modes.admin_dashboard: Mode B: High Density. 100% width utilization. No jagged bottoms.
modes.subscriber_portal: Mode A: Tetris Grid. Asymmetrical layout with 'Hero' and 'Filler' blocks.

general: Use 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text. Import them via Google Fonts in index.css.
Implement a 'Theme Toggle' but default to the role-specific theme (e.g., Admin = Dark Mode preference, Subscriber = Light Mode preference).
For the Cashier module, ensure buttons are LARGE and touch-friendly.
For the Technician module, ensure the UI is mobile-responsive first.
Use 'Recharts' for all data visualization (Sales, Bandwidth usage).
CRITICAL: Do not use default Shadcn colors. Override them with the 'Eco-Fintech' palette defined above.

pages.login: Split screen. Left: Branding/Art (Green abstract). Right: Clean form.
pages.admin_dashboard: Use 'Grid Borders' style. Dense data. Top row: 4 Key Metrics (Gross Sales, Net Sales, Active Subs, Expenses).
pages.subscriber_portal: Use 'Glassmorphism'. Friendly greeting. Big 'Pay Now' button. Usage chart prominent.

universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx`
